final: WITH fee_order_user AS (SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.recordvault, u.acctscope FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp), per_order_net AS (SELECT acctscope, recordvault, AVG(feerate) - AVG(rebrate) as net_fee_rate FROM fee_order_user GROUP BY acctscope, recordvault), per_scope AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_fee_rate) as scope_avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM per_order_net GROUP BY acctscope), plain_avg AS (SELECT AVG(scope_avg_net_rate) as overall_avg FROM per_scope) SELECT ps.acctscope, ps.scope_avg_net_rate, ps.order_count, ps.scope_avg_net_rate - pa.overall_avg as difference_from_plain_average FROM per_scope ps, plain_avg pa ORDER BY ps.acctscope
